caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-length dress with a wide, bell-shaped skirt and fitted bodice, shown without a body or mannequin inside. The dress is primarily cream or off-white in color and is covered throughout with a pattern of slender green stems, leaves, and small clusters of pink, yellow, and light purple flowers. The sleeves are long and loose, matching the floral pattern of the dress. Draped over the shoulders is a short, white cape or mantle with a geometric border design in gray. The cape features a simple circular brooch or button at the center of the neckline, with a blue center and gold rim. The composition is centered on the page with the dress symmetrically displayed, and there are no additional objects or background features present in the drawing.
title: Dress with Cape Collar
